### Team leads

Shannon Rankin (SWFSC), Kourtney Burger (SWFSC), Bella Garfield (NEFSC), Becca Van Hoeck (NEFSC)

### Goals

The overarching goal of the Open Science team is to facilitate adoption of Open Science Methods into our day to day research activities.

### Action Items

1.  [**Openscapes**](https://openscapes.org/){target="_blank"} **PAM Team Cohort:** Openscapes is an initiative focused on promoting open and reproducible science, while fostering collaboration, transparency, and accessibility among reseachers. The PAM SI Team will have representatives from every fisheries center participating in the Openscapes Fall 2024 cohort. This cohort will serve as the backbone of our Open Science effort, and methods developed during the Openscapes project will be detailed in our stand-along [Open Science repository](https://nmfs-ost.github.io/PAM-OpenScience/){target="_blank"}. ***Update:** Fall cohort complete, successful development of Lab Manuals (see below).*

2.  **Lab Manual:** Development of a [National Lab Manual](https://nmfs-ost.github.io/PAM_National_Network/) and a Lab Manual for each Science Center ([PIFSC](https://pifsc-protected-species-division.github.io/CRP_PAM_Manual/), [NEFSC](https://nefsc.github.io/NEFSC_PAB_lab_manual/), [SEFSC](https://sefsc.github.io/SEFSC-PAM-Lab-Manual/), [SWFSC](https://sael-swfsc.github.io/SAEL-lab-manual/), [NWFSC](https://noaa-nwfsc.github.io/NWFSC-PAM-Lab-Manual/), [AFSC](https://noaa-afsc.github.io/AFSC-MML-PAM-Lab-Manual/)). This was be initiated during the Openscapes program, and these serve as a landing page for all information related to the activities of each lab. This will lead to increased transparency and will facilitate information sharing between NOAA Science Centers, outside partners, and the public. ***Update:** All sites created, updates ongoing as of June 2026. Future developments and updates led by PAM Open Science Committee (see below).*

3.  **PAM-SI Team Organization :** Transition to PAM Open Science (PAM-OS) Committee, with representatives from each science center, during FY26. This PAM-Open Science committee will manage a PAM-OS calendar, with weekly coworking sessions. It will also facilitate cross-center coordination of activities, updating PAM National Network page, facilitating open science adoption by all NMFS PAM researchers, and will foster a community of collaboration. Cross-center research collaborations will be organized by teams, with landing pages for each [PAM-SI team](https://nmfs-ost.github.io/PAM_National_Network/content/SI%20coord/SI_Coordination.html). This will allow for increased coordination, transparency and information sharing within and outside of these teams. ***Update:** PAM-OS Committee developed as of May 2026 and coordinated PAM-OS outreach initiated during PAM-SI Open Science Update in June 2026. This effort is intended to be ongoing.*

4.  **Research Compendiums:** A research compendium is a comprehensive collection of all the digital components related to a research project, including data, code, and text (protocols, reports, metadata, etc). We have developed a [research compendium template](https://sael-swfsc.github.io/PAM_template_ResearchCompendium/) with set of [best practices](https://nmfs-ost.github.io/PAM-OpenScience/content/researchCompendium.html) to encourage standardization of NMFS PAM Research Compendiums. ***Update:** Compendium and best practices developed.*
